name: Non-syndromic Limb Reduction Defect

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Non-syndromic Limb Reduction Defect

criteria.description: Congenital absence or hypoplasia of one or more limbs or limb segments without associated systemic anomalies
No clinical or genetic evidence of syndromic conditions known to cause limb reduction defects
Radiographic evidence confirming limb bone deficiency or absence
Negative or non-contributory family history for syndromic limb anomalies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital limb deficiency confirmed by clinical and radiologic evaluation, with exclusion of syndromic causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may be performed to exclude syndromic or chromosomal abnormalities.

pathognomonic.notes: Complete absence of distal limb segments across the limb axis
searchTerms: missing part of limb at birth

pathognomonic.notes: Partial or complete absence of bones along the longitudinal axis of the limb

common.notes: Reduced length of affected limb bones

common.symptomName: Restricted range of motion in affected limb joints
common.notes: Limited joint mobility due to structural abnormalities
searchTerms: stiff joints in affected arm or leg

common.notes: Altered walking pattern secondary to limb deficiency
searchTerms: walking changes to compensate limb difference
adjusted gait due to limb issues

occasional.symptomName: Muscle hypoplasia adjacent to limb deficiency
occasional.notes: Underdevelopment of muscles near the affected limb
searchTerms: underdeveloped muscles near missing limb part
weak muscles next to limb defect

occasional.notes: Difference in size or shape between limbs
searchTerms: mild asymmetry of arms or legs

occasional.symptomName: Skin dimpling or scarring at limb deficiency site
occasional.notes: Surface skin changes overlying absent limb segments
searchTerms: scars on skin at limb missing area

occasional.notes: Severe limb shortening with hand or foot attached close to trunk
searchTerms: limbs with very short or absent segments

rare.notes: Curvature of the spine secondary to limb length discrepancy
Limited joint extension or flexion in unaffected limbs

rare.symptomName: Transient peripheral edema in affected limb
rare.notes: Occasional swelling due to lymphatic or vascular anomalies
searchTerms: short-term fluid buildup in arm or leg

imaging: Radiographs showing absence or hypoplasia of limb bones
MRI to assess soft tissue and muscle involvement
genetic: Exclusion of known syndromic mutations (e.g., HOXD13, TBX5)
No consistent pathogenic variants identified in isolated cases
other: Clinical examination confirming isolated limb deficiency without systemic involvement

distinguishingFeatures: Additional systemic features such as cardiac defects
Multiple congenital anomalies including vertebral, anal, cardiac, tracheoesophageal, renal, and limb defects
Presence of syndromic features beyond limb reduction

redFlags: Presence of systemic anomalies suggesting syndromic diagnosis
Progressive limb deformities or worsening function
Family history of syndromic limb malformations
references: Orphanet: Non-syndromic Limb Reduction Defect - ORPHA:93457
Hunter AGW, et al. Limb Reduction Defects. In: Emery's Elements of Medical Genetics. 15th ed. 2019.
Gold NB, et al. Epidemiology of limb reduction defects in the United States. Am J Med Genet A. 2011.
